summary.intent: Manage a GSD milestone across phases 69–71 using the single-terminal manager dashboard: verify/complete a stalled phase, plan and execute the next phase, ship it, resolve PR reviews, and insert a new remediation phase for a discovered soundness gap.
summary.outcome: Phase 69 marked complete (already merged), Phase 70 (rotation soundness) planned, executed, and shipped as PR #596 — catching and fixing a critical concurrent-add revocation TOCTOU bug — then merged to main; Phase 71 discussed with 9 decisions locked; PR review (10 threads) fully resolved surfacing a real depth≥2 crash-resume soundness gap; new Phase 70.1 inserted into the roadmap to track that gap plus 2 hardening followups.

repo: gsd-tools `init.manager`'s partial/complete status derivation globs `*PLAN*.md` in phase directories and can miscount research docs (e.g. `69-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md`) as an extra plan, showing a phase as `partial` even when `verify phase-completeness` correctly reports 25/25 — cosmetic bug, not a real incompleteness signal

`ipns_records.user_id` is documented in-code as a non-authoritative 'denormalized creator marker' — root/entity ownership authority is proven by signature, not row ownership; `vaults.owner_id` (FK, unique) is the actual purpose-built root-ownership binding

TEE lease-renewer (post-Phase 67) structurally cannot repoint CID on republish — `renewIpnsRecord` re-signs existing value+sequence and the request body has no `metadataCid` field, and republish uses a separate EOL-only write path that never touches `latestCid` — so same-seq+different-CID is always an anomaly, making CID-equivocation hard-guard safe

Plan 70-04's `enqueueConcurrentlyAddedChildren` over-reached its spec by calling `rotateOne` on concurrently-added children, requiring a write key the rotator may not hold, plus an orphaned-parent-pointer bug (enqueue ran before `parentTracking.delete`) — design intent (§4.5, ROT-05, RR-01) was merge+re-seal, not rotate; fixed via `createConcurrentAddResealingMerge`

Rotation crash-resume e2e Test 4 (phase 70-08) validated only a childless-root tree by construction, so SC#2/SC#3 'passed' vacuously — real depth≥2 mid-walk crash-resume soundness (stale dirty-key reuse, dirty-frontier consumption being depth-1-only) was never exercised and remains an open gap (`2026-07-08-rotation-crash-resume-depth2-soundness-gap.md`)
`rotation-high-water.ts:1341`-area client code still uses a cached generation value instead of the freshly-resolved one (hardening-followups item 5, left open)
`sdk-core/src/rotation/high_water.rs:35-46` explicitly documents cross-store atomic transaction as out-of-scope for Phase 70's SC#5

code.finding: Dirty-frontier consumption path only handles depth-1 nodes and reuses a stale child key at dirty edges — confirmed real by both greptile and CodeRabbit re-review, deferred as a structural gap rather than patched under time pressure
bump_lock was acquired after the floor check, creating a TOCTOU allowing anti-rollback bypass under concurrency; fixed by widening the lock to cover check+bump atomically (commit 98a6265b7)

workflow: Backgrounding GSD plan/execute agents in Claude Code (which lacks true background Task isolation) causes branch collisions when both the foreground session and the background agent write to the same shared checkout — background agent silently switched branches out from under the foreground session's uncommitted work

Always independently re-verify a subagent's 'all tests pass' report on load-bearing gates (live e2e, security fixes) rather than trusting the summary — done twice this session (rotation gate re-run, fix re-run) and caught nothing wrong, but was correctly treated as mandatory

When multiple review bots (CodeRabbit + greptile) review the same PR, expect duplicate/overlapping findings restated after fix-commits trigger re-review — must re-triage and resolve the same finding twice under different thread IDs

Use `phase next-decimal N` to find the next free decimal sub-phase number (e.g. 70 → 70.1) before inserting a remediation phase, mirroring the existing 68.1/68.2 precedent for consolidating a shipped phase's residual work

friction: `gsd-tools phase complete` updated ROADMAP/STATE/requirements but the manager dashboard still showed Phase 69 as `partial` due to the plan-file glob miscount, requiring extra investigation to confirm it was cosmetic
Background bgIsolation guard blocked the Write tool for CONTEXT.md; required editing settings.local.json (gitignored) to add `bgIsolation: none` before the write would succeed

Background plan-70 agent switched the shared working tree to its own branch mid-session, stranding Phase 69-completion edits and Phase 71 CONTEXT as uncommitted changes on the wrong branch — required post-hoc git archaeology (`git show` per commit) to separate entangled Phase 69/70/71 changes into distinct branches

execute-phase's branch-naming init computed a different truncated branch name than the one the plan-70 agent had already created, requiring a manual rename to avoid forking a duplicate branch without the plans
Docker stack for cipherbox conflicted in appearance with an unrelated project's containers on similar ports, requiring careful verification before bringing up the correct stack
sdk-e2e README lacked the full stack bring-up recipe, requiring a fallback read of docs/DEVELOPMENT.md
zsh array syntax broke the thread reply/resolve loop, requiring a rewrite as a Node.js script for reliable GitHub GraphQL mutations with retries
Git commit commands twice appeared to time out (signing-related) but had actually landed, requiring `git log` verification rather than blind retry — consistent with prior known false-negative pattern
A 10th PR review thread appeared after fix commits triggered CodeRabbit/greptile re-review, requiring another triage round after believing all 9 were resolved
open_items: Rotation crash-resume depth≥2 soundness gap (T1/T2/T8) — dirty-frontier consumption is depth-1-only, stale key reuse at dirty edges, and the fundamental unrecoverable-post-rotation-key limitation — now scoped into new Phase 70.1 pending planning/execution
Hardening-followups todo items 1 (cross-store floor atomicity) and 5 (reconcile cached generation in client.ts) — also folded into Phase 70.1 scope
Floor-write-failure propagation (T4, HighWaterStore::put signature change) — heavy lift, folded into the hardening-followups todo for future work
Phase 70.1 was inserted into ROADMAP.md and STATE.md on a branch but not yet committed/PR'd (commit was in progress when transcript ends)
Phase 69's roadmap-checkbox bookkeeping rides inside the Phase 70 PR rather than its own — accepted as low-value to separate
Phases 72 and 73 remain unplanned; Phase 71 is discussed (CONTEXT.md on branch feat/phase-71-share-invite-security) but not yet planned/executed
rootNodeId in share-invites remains client-asserted (not persisted/validated as a pair with rootIpnsName) per Phase 71 decision D-02 — noted as an accepted gap, not a bug to fix now
